scene: You step off the tram into ticking Clocktower Square.
picture: Flat side-view pixel art of cobbled Clocktower Square. A red tram sits far left beside a wooden grandfather clock. In the centre stands a young Black woman with a round afro, yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella. To the right is a brass workshop door, and up high hangs an iron ladder.
shown: a tall wooden grandfather clock standing ticking on the cobbled sidewalk far left
a polished brass workshop door with a gear-shaped knocker on the right
an iron maintenance ladder bolted beneath the giant ticking face up high
